rationale: RFC_056 (docs/agent_docs/docs024_key_docs_latest/architecture_review/RFC_056_the_site_acceptance_council_is_the_improvement_loop_and_its_seats_are_the_benchmark.md). Owner rulings 2026-08-25: the site acceptance council runs AFTER THE FACT in the improvement loop, routing to existing agents; N = 6 structures unless the site refuses; and, later the same day: 'turn off the evolutionary aspect of the improvement loop for now - the bit that keeps rewriting pages that have been judged to be good for the sake of aspirational improvements. It should stay ... switch just that bit off and turn the improvement loop back on.' WHAT IS WRONG, measured. The loop's four LLM seats (design-audit -> visual-design-auditor + content-quality-auditor; site-review-agent; offer-analyser; brief-fidelity-auditor) file OPINIONS about pages that work, and write_audit_findings routes them to handlers that REGENERATE the page (content_rewrite / needs_content_page / tone_shift -> page-build-handler; needs_content_planning -> content-gap-planner). [MEASURED 2026-08-25, site_work_items UNION archive] design-audit source alone, lifetime: 976 content_rewrite, 399 needs_content_page, 964 needs_content_planning. bugs_open/238: one tone_shift regenerated finetuning.uk's homepage grid and served five . And 'the sweep is off' was never 'the rewrites are off': detected-item-promoter (live since 08-15, every 900s) promotes any 'detected' row whose (item_type, handler) pair ever completed - [MEASURED] 26 LLM-audit rows promoted 08-20..08-24 while improvement-sweep was disabled. IMP-054's premise ('a lone discovery run files findings nothing can ever see') is void; 'detected' is a queue. THE RULE (RFC_056 rule 3): defects dispatch; opinions record. A mechanical finding may route to a fixer as today. A model seat's finding becomes a VERDICT ROW - same row, same dedup key, parked - undispatchable by construction until a person releases it. THE SEAM (Go, this submission): an opt-in setting `filing_mode` on write_audit_findings, declared in ConfigKeys (the conditional_branch precedent; RFC_022's budget counts len(Optional) and is unmoved - parity test passes). Absent/'dispatch' -> byte-identical behaviour (the common-case output map is unchanged). 'record' -> classified findings with a handler are transformed by a pure function: HandlerAgent '' + Status 'deferred' (each alone is not enough - the promoter's door is the handler, triage's door is 'detected'; the test asserts BOTH), with spec.routed_handler / routed_status / filing_mode / deferred_by / deferred_reason / release_recipe (bugs_open/396: 'deferred' with a named handler and no provenance is the estate's missing park verb - this is deliberately not that shape). Any other value is an ERROR, never a silent dispatch. Already-parked rows (capability_gap) pass through untouched. Zero live steps name the key as of 2026-08-25 (five live write_audit_findings steps, all exactly site_id/audit_source/findings_field). THE SEATS (Go, this submission): three of the four missing lenses as discovery checks, registered via init() and NOT NAMED in any checks array - inert until a migration names them (IMP-004's safe-rollout pattern). All flag-only (HandlerAgent '', Status 'detected'), self-clearing via CheckResult.Resolved on a positive re-observation only, blinded-is-not-healthy (invented-path control 200s -> error, nothing filed), caps with the dropped tail logged. build_prerequisites (4 SQL predicates; never mints - bugs_open/380 D1), heading_promise (a served page's own headings vs its chrome-stripped non-anchor body; nominates, does not adjudicate), structure_floor (N=6 distinct DELIVERED structures, refusal recordable at sites.settings). Item types declared as acknowledged verifier gaps; lifecycle postures declared. 38 new tests; both packages green; verify-head-builds.sh --with all ten files against HEAD f3c1da996: OK. THE CONFIG (two HOLD migrations, this submission, NOT applied - the owner asked for a plan): 619 moves ONE edge so the four model seats are bypassed (not deleted) and the sweep can go back on today; 620, after the roll, creates acceptance-discovery-agent (the three checks on their own 300s timeout) and reader-experience-auditor (the fourth seat, filing_mode record from birth), sets filing_mode record on the five existing model seats, rewires the loop, and gives every seat call and both enrichment steps a record__failed step (deferred capability_gap, the record_not_converging shape) with a check_seats_ran gate that withholds record_audit_pass when any seat failed - closing the 9-step fail-open surface the vigilant lane measured (7 of 8 seat calls have error_step == next_step; error_step has TWO spellings and 620 leaves exactly one). Both rehearsed against the live rows in rolled-back transactions, including apply-then-rollback in one transaction; live rows untouched. Consumers told (2026-07-29 ruling 3): vigilant_designer_offer_analysis (offer-analyser, brief-fidelity; they hold the sweep switch and asked that routing be argued in the RFC), copy_quality_two_stage (content-quality-auditor), the 390 lane (render-audit rotation is NOT touched and is named as the other live source of bad renders).

Config, HOLD, not applied: 619 bypasses the four model seats with one edge; 620 (after the roll) adds the acceptance and reader seats, sets record mode on all six model seats, and makes every seat failure a durable row that withholds the audit-pass stamp. plan.risks: 1) EXPECTED OBJECTION - 'a record row occupies the finding's dedup slot, so a later dispatch-mode filing of the same finding is a duplicate'. Yes, by design: one row per finding whichever mode filed it; release is the recipe on the row. State it, do not fix it. 2) check_seats_ran reads seat_failed_<seat>.item_type == capability_gap, relying on create_work_item returning item_type whether it inserted or deduped (create_work_item_action.go:407-412 returns inserted/item_type/handler_agent/site_id/item_key/deduped) and on the conditional evaluator treating a nil field as unequal to a bare literal. The DDL rehearsal cannot exercise the evaluator; the first live run after 620 must be watched at check_seats_ran (induce one seat failure). If the evaluator compares nil == 'capability_gap' as true, every sweep would skip the pass stamp - loud, not silent, and the else-arm is the safe one. 3) The three checks are inert until named; their first live pass is expected to file on MOST sites (22/31 lack page_research, 22/31 lack feed_sources). That is a census, not noise, and every row is flag-only. A reviewer may object to volume; the answer is that flag-only rows dispatch nothing and self-clear, and the prerequisite absences are real route defects (316, 376). 4) heading_promise and structure_floor fetch up to 40 pages each; on acceptance-discovery-agent's own 300s timeout. A slow site can still time out -> record_acceptance_discovery_failed row, sweep continues, pass withheld. 5) 620's operator assertion (FILING_MODE_SHIPPED) is a declaration, not a probe - RFC_040: a migration cannot ask the binary what it can do. Applied against an older binary the unknown key is ignored and the seats DISPATCH: that is why the file refuses the placeholder and the header names the ancestry check. 6) Two spellings of error_step: 620 sets step-level and removes the config-level twin on the enrichment steps; the verify block RAISEs if a config-level twin survives. A future editor adding a config-level error_step on a call_* step would shadow nothing (step-level wins) but would mislead a census - noted in the RFC. 7) The reader prompt's page list is built from regexp_matches over rendered_html <h1>/<h2>; pages with headings only in chrome or images read as '(no headings)'. It is a prompt input, not a verdict; the model is told every current_value must come from the list. 8) BLD-006 superseded, not joined (RFC_056 Q3) - the register entry for it is NOT edited in this submission; the RFC asks the architecture seat to rule first.
